ARAGAIN-FALLS.visual: At the brink of Aragain Falls, the river thunders 450 feet into misty depths while a shimmering, solid rainbow arches westward across the roaring water.

ATLANTIS-ROOM.visual: Your lamp reveals an ancient chamber once drowned beneath the reservoir, its silt-caked columns and slimy, barnacled walls still dripping as a worn staircase climbs into darkness.

ATTIC.visual: A cramped, pitch-black attic under steep rafters, its dusty floorboards creaking, cobwebs hanging from bare beams, and a narrow stairway dropping back down to the kitchen.

BAT-ROOM.visual: A cramped, dank chamber reeking of guano, where leathery wings rustle overhead and a vampire bat stirs among the low, dripping stalactites.

CANYON-BOTTOM.visual: Sheer reddish canyon walls tower overhead, their rough face looking just climbable, while a modest stream of Aragain Falls runoff murmurs past below in the daylight.

CANYON-VIEW.visual: From the windswept west rim, the Great Canyon plunges away below you, the Frigid River glinting far down and Aragain Falls shimmering under a rainbow to the north.

CELLAR.visual: A dank, pitch-black cellar of wet stone, a slick metal ramp gleaming faintly to the west as the trap door slams shut overhead and the bar thuds into place.

CHASM-ROOM.visual: A narrow path hugs the south lip of a bottomless chasm slashing southwest to northeast, its black depths swallowing your lamplight while a crack splits the rock beside you.

CLEARING.visual: Sunlight pools in a small grassy clearing where a well-worn forest path runs east toward the canyon and west back behind the white house, ringed by tall trees.

CLIFF-MIDDLE.visual: You cling to a narrow sunlit ledge halfway up the canyon wall, the river twisting away far below while craggy, climbable cliffs rise overhead toward the open sky.

COLD-PASSAGE.visual: Your lamp reveals a cold, damp corridor of glistening grey stone, water beading on the walls as the long east-west passage bends sharply southward into darkness.

CYCLOPS-ROOM.visual: A gloomy stone chamber with bloodstained walls, where a hulking one-eyed cyclops looms at the foot of a staircase climbing into darkness, eyeing you hungrily.

DAM-BASE.visual: The colossal concrete face of Flood Control Dam #3 looms overhead as the Frigid River rushes past, hemmed in by towering White Cliffs stretching away downstream.

DAM-LOBBY.visual: A drab concrete waiting room for dam tours, lined with worn benches under humming lamps, its doorways stencilled "Private" while the dam's walkway stretches away south.

features: control panel with large metal bolt
DAM-ROOM.visual: Atop the vast concrete crest of Flood Control Dam #3, a bolted control panel glows with a serene green bubble while the reservoir stretches behind and water roars below.

DAMP-CAVE.visual: Your lamp glistens on sweating rock walls as mud squelches underfoot; water drips from the low ceiling, and a hairline crack splits the southern wall.

DEAD-END-1.visual: The twisty passage simply stops: cold, featureless rock closes in on three sides, your lamp's glow dying against walls identical to every other turn of the maze.

DEAD-END-2.visual: The twisting passage ends abruptly against a blank wall of damp, rough-hewn rock, your lamplight pooling on cold stone with nowhere left to go but back.

DEAD-END-3.visual: The twisting passage ends abruptly against a blank wall of damp, featureless rock; your lamp reveals nothing but the narrow way you came in.

DEAD-END-4.visual: The twisting passage ends abruptly in a blank wall of damp, featureless rock, your lamplight pooling on rubble in a cramped pocket of the maze.

DEAD-END-5.visual: The tunnel stops abruptly against a blank wall of black rock, old timbers sagging overhead and coal dust thick underfoot, with nowhere to go but back north.

DEEP-CANYON.visual: You stand on the south lip of a deep underground canyon, a stone stairway plunging into darkness while a loud roar of rushing water echoes up from below.

DOME-ROOM.visual: A narrow ledge rings the rim of a vast stone dome, a weathered wooden railing guarding a dizzying plunge into blackness, while an eerie draught tugs you toward the edge.

EAST-OF-CHASM.visual: Your lamp catches a crumbling ledge on the east lip of a vast chasm whose depths swallow the light entirely, while a cold draft rises from the endless black below.

EAST-OF-HOUSE.visual: Behind the gleaming white house, a small window in one corner hangs slightly ajar, while a worn path slips eastward into the dense, sun-dappled forest.

EGYPT-ROOM.visual: Your lamp reveals a cramped Egyptian tomb, sandstone walls crowded with faded hieroglyphs and painted pharaohs, a stone staircase climbing west into darkness.

END-OF-RAINBOW.visual: Sunlight pours into the opened canyon onto a narrow pebbly beach hemmed by towering White Cliffs, while a shimmering rainbow arcs over the thundering falls to the east.

ENGRAVINGS-CAVE.visual: Your lamp sweeps a low, cramped cave where old engravings, incised into the living rock by an unknown hand, depict the beliefs of the ancient Zorkers.

ENTRANCE-TO-HADES.visual: A vast gateway looms, carved 'Abandon every hope all ye who enter here!', while ashen wraiths jeer from the open gate and lamenting voices echo from the desolation beyond.

EW-PASSAGE.visual: A cramped passage of rough brown rock stretches east to west, while at its north end a narrow stairway drops steeply into the dark.

FOREST-1.visual: Tall trees crowd in on every side, their canopy swallowing the light, while a faint glow of sunlight filters through the trunks to the east.

FOREST-2.visual: Massive trees crowd close on every side, their tangled canopy swallowing the daylight, leaving only a dim green gloom over moss, roots and drifts of fallen leaves.

FOREST-3.visual: Huge dark trunks crowd around you beneath a heavy canopy, tangled undergrowth choking the east and storm-felled timber heaped to the south in murky green light.

GALLERY.visual: A lamplit underground art gallery, its cream walls marked by pale rectangles and empty gilt frames where vandals with exceptional taste stripped away nearly every painting.

GAS-ROOM.visual: A cramped, sooty chamber reeking of coal gas, a faint sickly haze hanging over rough rock, with worn stairs climbing up and a narrow tunnel slipping east.

GRATING-CLEARING.visual: A sunlit clearing ringed by dense forest, where a pile of fallen leaves sits beside a sturdy iron grating set into the earth, hinting at darkness below.

GRATING-ROOM.visual: A cramped stone chamber at the maze's edge, where an iron grating set in the ceiling, clasped by a skull-and-crossbones lock, hints at the forest world above.

IN-STREAM.visual: Your boat drifts on a gently flowing underground stream, lamplight catching twisting rock walls that hide the way downstream, while a narrow sandy beach offers a place to land.

KITCHEN.visual: A homely farmhouse kitchen lit by daylight through a small east window, a worn table recently used for cooking, a sooty chimney and a dark staircase climbing upward.

LADDER-BOTTOM.visual: A wide, black-walled mine chamber swallows your lamplight; on one side a narrow wooden ladder climbs up into darkness, its rungs worn and dusted with coal.

LADDER-TOP.visual: A cramped, coal-blackened chamber where a rickety wooden ladder sags into darkness from one corner, while worn stone steps climb back toward the mine above.

LAND-OF-LIVING-DEAD.visual: A cold, mist-choked cavern where the weeping of countless lost souls echoes endlessly, and in one corner the bones of less fortunate adventurers lie stacked high.

features: nailed wooden door with gothic lettering
LIVING-ROOM.visual: A cozy, lamplit living room: a glass trophy case gleams beside a nailed-shut door bearing strange gothic lettering, while a rich oriental rug sprawls across the worn floorboards.

LOUD-ROOM.visual: A vast cavern whose ceiling vanishes into blackness, a stone stairway climbing upward, and a deafening, rushing roar echoing from every wall until thought itself drowns.

features: heavy iron chain hanging in shaft
LOWER-SHAFT.visual: A cramped, drafty chamber of raw rock where a cold wind sighs down a long shaft overhead, a heavy iron chain dangling into the lamplight from the darkness above.

MACHINE-ROOM.visual: A large, cold chamber at the mine's bottom where, in one corner, a squat metal machine like a clothes dryer waits, its tiny START switch glinting in your lamplight.

MAINTENANCE-ROOM.visual: Your lamp sweeps a ransacked concrete room of empty racks and scattered debris, halting on a wall panel of four buttons: blue, yellow, brown and red.

MAZE-1.visual: Your lamp flickers across cramped, twisting stone passages that bend away identically in every direction, their rough walls indistinguishable, the Troll Room's faint stench lingering eastward.

MAZE-10.visual: Your lamp reveals cramped, twisting passages of rough grey-brown rock, each bend identical to the last, curling off into darkness east, west and upward.

MAZE-11.visual: Your lamp reveals yet another cramped knot of twisty little passages, rough grey-brown rock curving off in every direction, each one maddeningly like the last.

MAZE-12.visual: Your lamp reveals cramped, twisting stone passages identical to every other, branching up, down and sideways until all sense of direction dissolves into gloom.

MAZE-13.visual: Your lamp reveals cramped, featureless passages of grey-brown rock twisting off in every direction, each one maddeningly identical to the last.

MAZE-14.visual: Your lamp reveals yet another cramped junction of twisting stone passages, each identical to the last, branching off into darkness in every direction.

MAZE-15.visual: Your lamp flickers over identical rough stone walls twisting off in every direction, the cramped passages so alike that you can no longer tell where you came from.

MAZE-2.visual: Your lamp flickers across identical damp stone walls bending away in every direction, each twisty little passage indistinguishable from the last, swallowing all sense of direction.

MAZE-3.visual: Your lamp reveals cramped, featureless stone passages twisting off in every direction, each bend identical to the last, swallowing all sense of where you came from.

MAZE-4.visual: Your lamp reveals yet another cramped junction of twisty little passages, every rough stone wall identical, the darkness swallowing each turn ahead.

MAZE-5.visual: Your lamp reveals yet another twisty little passage, all alike, where a luckless adventurer's bleached skeleton lies slumped against the cold stone.

MAZE-6.visual: Your lamp reveals another cramped junction of twisty little passages, rough grey-brown walls curving away up, down, and sideways, utterly indistinguishable from the last.

MAZE-7.visual: Your lamp reveals yet another cramped junction of twisty little passages, all alike, rough grey-brown walls curving away in every direction, one sloping upward, another dropping down.

MAZE-8.visual: Your lamp reveals yet another cramped bend of twisty little passages, every damp grey-brown wall maddeningly identical to the last, branching off into darkness.

MAZE-9.visual: Your lamp reveals cramped, twisting passages of grey-brown rock, each turning bend indistinguishable from the last, branching off in every direction into darkness.

MINE-1.visual: Your lamp picks out black, glittering coal seams and sagging timber props in a cramped, nondescript tunnel that branches confusingly into more identical darkness.

MINE-2.visual: A cramped, featureless tunnel of black coal, its glistening seams catching your lamplight, with sagging timber props and passages branching off identically into darkness.

MINE-3.visual: Your lamp flickers across black, glittering coal walls propped by splintered timbers, the cramped tunnel branching off into identical darkness in every direction.

MINE-4.visual: Your lamp picks out black, glinting coal walls propped by sagging timber beams, the twisting tunnels all looking maddeningly alike in the choking, dusty darkness.

MINE-ENTRANCE.visual: Your lamp picks out soot-black rock and sagging timber beams framing a gaping shaft in the west wall, the air thick with old coal dust and silence.

MIRROR-ROOM-1.visual: A tall, square stone chamber swallows your lamplight, its entire south wall a colossal mirror now cracked into a jagged web of glinting, broken reflections.

MIRROR-ROOM-2.visual: A tall, square stone chamber whose entire south wall is one enormous mirror, reflecting you and the three dark exits back into the room.

MOUNTAINS.visual: The trees thin to scattered trunks, and beyond them sheer grey mountains rise like a wall, their jagged peaks cutting off any hope of going farther east.

NARROW-PASSAGE.visual: Rough stone walls press in on both sides as the long north-south corridor squeezes even tighter, your lamplight scraping along damp, jagged rock just inches away.

NORTH-OF-HOUSE.visual: The doorless north face of a white clapboard house looms before you, its windows nailed shut with weathered boards, while a narrow path snakes north into the trees.

NORTH-TEMPLE.visual: Massive marble pillars frame the north end of a vast, hushed temple, where a faded prayer in a forgotten tongue crowns a staircase descending into darkness.

NS-PASSAGE.visual: Your lamp barely reaches the ceiling of this tall, narrow passage, where rough stone walls stretch north and a branch splits off northeast into the darkness.

ON-RAINBOW.visual: You stand atop a shimmering, solid rainbow arching east to west, the thundering Aragain Falls glittering beside you and mist swirling over the gorge far below.

PATH.visual: A narrow dirt path winds north-south through a dim, hushed forest, where one enormous tree with low, inviting branches leans out over the trail.

RESERVOIR.visual: Black water stretches across a vast cavern, its surface stirring with current; a thin stream spills from a rocky cleft upstream while the great dam looms downstream.

RESERVOIR-NORTH.visual: A vast dark cavern opens before you, its muddy northern shore lapping against a wide black reservoir, while a slimy stairway climbs away into the gloom behind.

RESERVOIR-SOUTH.visual: A long, dark cavern hall ends at the muddy south shore of a vast black reservoir, its still waters stretching beyond your lamplight, far too deep to cross.

RIVER-1.visual: Your boat drifts on the cold, quiet Frigid River beneath the towering grey dam, a small landing on the west shore and pale white cliffs rising sheer to the east.

RIVER-2.visual: Black, icy water swings around a sharp bend, hiding the Dam behind you; pale White Cliffs rise sheer to the east while jagged boulders guard the western bank.

RIVER-3.visual: Black, icy water hurries downhill into a cavern valley, a thin beach hugging pale cliffs to the west, while a low rumble growls somewhere ahead in the darkness.

RIVER-4.visual: Your boat races through black, cold water as the roar of rushing water grows ahead; a pale sandy beach glimmers east, a thin strand hugs the white cliffs west.

RIVER-5.visual: Your boat pitches on the roaring Frigid River, spray flying from churning rapids, while a broad, flat landing area beckons from the east shore beneath towering rock walls.

ROUND-ROOM.visual: Your lamp sweeps a perfectly circular stone chamber ringed with passage mouths, several choked shut by heaps of fallen rock and rubble from old cave-ins.

SANDY-BEACH.visual: Your lamp glows over a broad underground beach of pale sand, where the dark river rushes past and a half-buried passage gapes in the drifts to the northeast.

SANDY-CAVE.visual: Your lamp reveals a cramped cave choked with soft drifted sand, its pale dunes rippling up against rough brown walls beneath a low, crumbling ceiling.

SHAFT-ROOM.visual: A large, dark rock chamber where a narrow shaft plunges into blackness, crowned by a rusty metal framework from which a heavy iron chain dangles into the void.

SHORE.visual: A narrow path hugs the east bank of a swift, treacherous river, its churning water rushing south toward a sharp rocky bend and the distant roar of falls.

SLIDE-ROOM.visual: A cramped, coal-dusted chamber where the words "Granite Wall" are etched into the south rock, and a steep metal slide twists down into blackness.

SMALL-CAVE.visual: A cramped, pitch-black pocket of rock closes around your lamplight, its damp walls glistening as worn stone steps spiral down toward a distant, watery chill.

SMELLY-ROOM.visual: A cramped, nondescript chamber of rough stone where a small staircase drops into darkness, and a foul, sulphurous stench drifts up to sting your nose.

SOUTH-OF-HOUSE.visual: The doorless south face of a white colonial house rises before you, its windows nailed shut with weathered boards, while dense forest crowds in behind you to the south.

SOUTH-TEMPLE.visual: At the temple's lit south end, a solemn stone altar rises before you, while in one corner a small dark hole drops away into blackness.

SQUEEKY-ROOM.visual: A cramped, lightless chamber of rough stone where faint, unsettling squeaks echo from the dark passage to the north, urging you toward the eastern escape.

STONE-BARROW.visual: A massive barrow of grey stone looms before you, its huge stone door in the east face standing open onto a darkness your eyes cannot pierce.

features: old wooden door with cyclops-sized hole
STRANGE-PASSAGE.visual: A long, dark stone passage ends at an old wooden door, a huge ragged hole smashed through it, clearly made by something cyclops-sized forcing its way out.

STREAM-VIEW.visual: A narrow stone path hugs a gently murmuring stream that trickles out of a tiny crack in the western rock and flows east into darkness toward the reservoir.

STUDIO.visual: Your lamp reveals a deserted artist's studio, every surface spattered in dozens of riotous colors, bare walls holding no paintings, and a sooty fireplace whose cramped chimney climbs into darkness.

TIMBER-ROOM.visual: A long, narrow mine passage choked with splintered, fallen timbers, where a cold draft whistles out of a tight crack at the far western end.

TINY-CAVE.visual: A cramped, tiny cave of rough brown rock closes around you, and in one corner a dark, forbidding staircase plunges downward into an ominous blackness.

TORCH-ROOM.visual: A vast domed chamber swallows your lamplight; a white marble pedestal stands at its heart while a frayed rope dangles from a wooden railing far overhead, just out of reach.

TREASURE-ROOM.visual: A vast, gloomy chamber hemmed by a sheer granite east wall, its floor littered with rotting sacks that crumble to dust; a staircase sinks into darkness below.

TROLL-ROOM.visual: A cramped, lamp-lit stone chamber whose walls are smeared with dried blood and gouged by deep axe scratches, while a black, forbidding hole yawns to the west.

TWISTING-PASSAGE.visual: A narrow, winding passage of rough brown stone curls away into blackness, its crooked walls pressing close as your lamp throws twisting shadows ahead.

UP-A-TREE.visual: Ten feet up, you nestle among thick, sturdy branches of a great tree, sunlight dappling through the leaves while the forest path winds far below your dangling feet.

WEST-OF-HOUSE.visual: An open grassy field stretches before a stately white house whose front door is nailed shut with weathered boards, a small mailbox standing nearby beneath the forest's edge.

WHITE-CLIFFS-NORTH.visual: A thin ribbon of pale sand hugs the foot of towering chalk-white cliffs, the dark Frigid River lapping softly beside you as your lamp glints off the stone.

WHITE-CLIFFS-SOUTH.visual: A cramped strip of rocky beach huddles beneath sheer white cliffs that glow faintly in your lamplight, while the dark Frigid River laps against the stones beside you.

WINDING-PASSAGE.visual: A narrow passage snakes through cold, damp rock, its walls bending out of sight so your lamplight never reaches far before the stone curves away again.
